records.title: Stripe subscription flows return to a nonexistent route
records.disposition_rationale: The route exists as a middleware redirect; page-file enumeration omitted middleware behavior.

records.title: Durable reconciliation abandons nonterminal tasks after ten polls
records.disposition_rationale: The durable recovery path stops without terminal or persisted continuation state.

records.title: Bailian callback capability is implicit and absent from ingress
records.disposition_rationale: The project specification explicitly marks Bailian callbacks unsupported and the supported provider path polls.

records.title: AI callback parses unbounded JSON
records.disposition_rationale: The externally reachable callback materializes JSON without an application byte limit.

records.title: Deployment guides name a callback secret the code never reads
records.disposition_rationale: Active deployment prose names a variable not read by executable callback signing code.

records.title: CSP blocks emitted Vercel observability scripts
records.disposition_rationale: The root layout emits scripts that the production security policy blocks.

records.title: DNS safety check is not bound to the media connection
records.disposition_rationale: A safe connection-pinning fix must preserve proxy behavior, redirect validation, streaming limits, and dispatcher cleanup.

records.title: Credit history uses incompatible transaction vocabularies
records.disposition_rationale: The public alias set lacks a total mapping across UI types and locales; the proposed patch remains incomplete.

records.title: QStash scheduler accepts credentials that its receiver rejects
records.disposition_rationale: Scheduler enablement and receiver authentication validate incompatible credential sets.

records.title: My Creations filters do not affect the requested result set
records.disposition_rationale: Rendered filter state is dropped before the request and service query.
